messages:
maria: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 429s over the last hour while the quota widget shows available tokens. Looks correlated with the multi-region migration we deployed at 02:00 UTC. 
ajay: Which customers? any common token/plan?
mar ia: @ajay — two enterprise tenants on Dedicated (eu-west + us-central). Plan looks fine, tokens left in UI. Support has screenshots, error samples.
cassie: Can we get an example API call + response body?
maria: Copied from customer A: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"rate limit enforced at enforcer-3 (region us-central)"}
```
They also sent the console screenshot showing quota remaining: 1.2M tokens.
liam: @maria can you paste the quota panel id? I want to check the rollup series.
maria: panel id: quota_overview.aggregation.30d (screenshot shows 'available' = 1.2M).
sophie: I just checked ingest-batcher logs — during migration the rollup-writer was restarted and backlog processing was rerouted to region shards. might be replay lag. ingest-bot: rollup-writer: stale-window-detection triggered for shard us-central at 1990012000; backlog=12m messages.
ajay: If the enforcement service reads from the real-time counters (enforcer store) but the console uses a daily-aggregated presentation, they can diverge if aggregation lag or a TTL gap occurs. Need to confirm whether enforcer uses per-token leaky-bucket or the aggregated counters.
cassie: Quick repro steps requested by support: 1) run repeated small requests until enforcer returns 429 2) check /console/api/usage?window=30d 3) compare token counters at enforcer host.
liam: I ran the internal check on enforcer-3: 
```
ssh enforcer-3
redis-cli --eval scripts/get_token_count.lua tenant:12345
# returned 0
```
maria: But UI shows 1.2M.
sophie: That indicates the UI rollup (timeseries writer) hasn't flushed the latest deltas to the materialized view; meanwhile the enforcer is reading the authoritative token bucket (which was drained). Why drained? backlog processing may have replayed heavy usage.
ajay: Two hypotheses: (A) replayed ingest from migration consumed tokens but rollup writer then compacted older deltas into the 30d view and accidentally overwrote with a stale snapshot, making UI show more tokens; (B) the enforcer is using per-region counters and routing gave tenant requests to a drained region.
cassie: I can pull the write-ahead logs for the tenant around 1990011000-1990012000 and check for replays.
liam: Also check the rollup-writer logs for any 'apply_snapshot' events — we saw a bug in snapshot merging that allowed older snapshots to replace newer deltas if timestamp ordering was off by <60s.
maria: Support asked for temporary mitigation to stop customer impact. Suggestions?
sophie: Short-term: force the enforcer to fallback to global quota store (global-bucket) so requests route to a region with capacity. I can push a canary patch to redirect tenant routing.
ajay: +1, but we need a safe feature-flag toggle. cassie, can you stage the flag?
cassie: On it — deploying flag 'enforcer.use_global_fallback' to prod as false -> true for tenant:12345. Will monitor.
[5m later]
cassie: flag flipped for tenant:12345. Monitoring — no new 429s for 3m.
maria: Customer confirmed their traffic is flowing again. :relieved: Thanks.
liam: Root cause next steps: 1) correlate rollup-writer snapshot times with replay window 2) patch snapshot-merge to use logical sequence numbers instead of wall clock 3) add alert for rollup lag > 2m 4) add consistency check between enforcer counters and console materialized view hourly.
sophie: I'll own 1+2. cassie, please create the alert and add the feature-flag docs. maria, please send customer update noting we've applied a temporary fallback and pursuing a permanent fix.
maria: Will do. Also adding postmortem note and recordings.
ajay: One more ask — can we add a small endpoint to show 'authoritative enforcement value' in the console (debug view) for enterprise customers so support can quickly triage?
cassie: Good idea, I'll add a small read-only route behind auth.
liam: Tagging follow-ups: ENG-MIGRATE, ENG-ENFORCER, SUPPORT-ESCALATIONS.
maria: Thank you everyone — closing the live ticket once postmortem draft is ready.
[thread end]
